proofs.assumptionsScope: Parameter val_rel_n_step_up only (the former NI step-up assumption); see parameters and sectionHypotheses
proofs.parametersNote: Coq Parameter declarations: the documented Trusted Computing Base (axioms in all but name); proved jointly satisfiable in domains/PhysicalSecurity.v
proofs.sectionHypothesesNote: Section Hypothesis declarations; they become premises of exported theorems. All are premises of termination/ReducibilityFull.v well_typed_SN, which are refutable (REQ-84) - the theorem is conditional/vacuous, not a termination guarantee
proofs.vacuityFindingsNote: scripts/detect-vacuous-proofs.py patterns (True conclusions, reflexivity on hard-coded records, := False definitions, definitional tautologies); ratcheted by audit-docs.sh

countingPolicy.note: The only Coq numbers to publish (mandate S2.7). core = Qed in foundations, type_system, properties, effects and termination, plus the compiler-link file crypto/AlgorithmPolicy.v; model = every other active file (domain, industry, compliance, crypto and runtime models: facts about their own definitions, not verified systems); excluded = proofs flagged by scripts/detect-vacuous-proofs.py, proofs resting on a premise the build refutes, counterexample proofs, every Example and Remark proof, and listed test files. The three add up to internal.coqQedActive. Vacuity patterns are heuristics, so excluded is a lower bound; the full counterexample triage is REQ-104. Computed by scripts/coq-counting-policy.py
